JevKT is above the best deep KT model at every position... and in 33/35 dataset–position cells (Table 9).

notes: The claim has two parts: (1) for new learners (P2, Table 9), the advantage of JevKT over deep KT holds from their first interactions; (2) on unseen items with all learners logged (P3), deep KT remains ahead, which is evaluated in Table 10 (and Table 42 / Figure 3b), not in this pack, so all forms are marked partial: true. Scope for the first part is ambiguous between mean across datasets ('narrow' reading on column 'Mean') and per-dataset cells ('broad' reading on the 7 dataset columns; Position 1 is also often treated separately in the text because it has only 41–50 targets per dataset and DBE has one class '–'). Exact tie noticed in Table 9: at 'Positions 11–15' in column 'DBE', 'Positions 11–15 > JevKT' (.773±.017) and 'Positions 11–15 > Best deep KT†' (.773±.035) have the exact same mean (.773).
